deploy-bot: Deploy started to devtest by @maya-ng — env=devtest, tag=v2.3.7-rc4, commit=abc1234def, rollout=canary(10%). changelog: fix batching edge-case + kv-cache perf tweaks.
maya-ng: kicking off smoke + canary. i'll monitor. @liam-r please watch 95p latency.
deploy-bot: Build succeeded: image sha=sha256:deadbeef. pushing to registry... :docker: 
deploy-bot: Image pushed. starting canary: 2 pods (10% traffic) -> targets: runtime-svc/devtest.
oncall-bot: Reminder: change window 03:00-04:00 UTC (approved).
sophia-t: running smoke tests: basic gen ok, auth + headers validated. quick sanity looks green.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics update (1m): 95p latency=820ms (+42% vs baseline 577ms), p50=120ms, errors=0.5% (baseline 0.2%). CPU on canary pods ~72%.
liam-r: that 95p jump is concerning. pausing full rollout. maya, can we revert canary and investigate? :warning:
maya-ng: agree, holding full rollout. initiating canary rollback to v2.3.6 now.
deploy-bot: Rolling back canary -> scheduling rollout to tag v2.3.6, draining canary pods, scaling stable.
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-svc -n devtest`
sophia-t: grabbing logs from the canary pods now, looking for long-tail op blocking. will paste snippets.
sophia-t: logs snippet: "2026-06-12T03:14:22Z svc:kv_cache miss=0.12 latency=780ms path=/api/v1/generate" (link: https://logs.internal/redwood/devtest/1865001234 )
liam-r: thanks, pulling perf traces and flamegraphs to see if kernel scheduling or kernel_worker queue spike.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Canary replaced by v2.3.6. Smoke checks on rollback pass. Deployment status: finished (rolled back).
maya-ng: thanks team. i'll open a follow-up issue for root cause + perf regression test. tagging @liam-r and @sophia-t.
liam-r: on it, will attach flamegraphs and trace IDs. ETA 45m.
sophia-t: will gather logs and test-case for CI to reproduce.
deploy-bot: Note: release notes for v2.3.7-rc4 remain unpublished since rollout did not complete.
maya-ng: FYI — no prod impact, devtest only. filing postmortem + action items. :white_check_mark:
